rationale: Y independently rediscovers and extends the single most significant ground-truth-confirmed bug (endpoint restrictions resolved from a pipeline that may not match the final deploy-overridden pipeline), while X actually asserts this is already fixed and 'can't diverge' — a precision miss given the ground truth shows this was a real, author-acknowledged bug.
